name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Broil marinated chicken 8-10 minutes until slightly charred. Set aside.
Melt butter in a large pan. Saute onion until golden, 8 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger. Cook 2 minutes.
Add remaining spices and cook 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and broiled chicken. Simmer 10 more minutes.
Serve over basmati rice with naan bread.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use coconut yogurt for the marinade and coconut cream instead of heavy cream.
substitutions.gluten_free: Already gluten-free — serve with rice instead of naan.
substitutions.low_carb: Skip the rice and naan, serve with cauliflower rice.

notes: The longer you marinate the chicken, the more flavorful it becomes.
